description: PoCI configurations, v3 messages, strict quorum, FFG + handoff + bans, evidence and finality certificates (reference/poci_reference.py)

notes.numbers: weights and totals are decimal strings (u128); heights and epochs are JSON integers
notes.test_signature: sig = sha256d(ds_test_sig || u8(depth) || root || u64le(epoch(target.height)) || msg_v3); a stand-in for kes::sign, anyone can compute it
notes.sequences: a PociChain on mainnet parameters launched at the checkpoint opening epoch 4 (height 2880, justified and finalized). Checkpoint hashes are cp_hash(height, branch) = sha256d('poci-vector-cp' || u64le(height) || u32le(branch)), branch 0 unless a link names [source_height, target_height, branch]. provider_calls[e] are the candidate weights of C_e before bans. A votes step: every listed voter (index into keys) signs justified -> target under the named configuration ('current' = in force, 'previous' = the one before it); voters in bad_sig carry 32 zero bytes instead. result.weight/total are the counted weight and the total of the configuration in force when the votes were counted; state is after the step. An evidence step: the block at `height` carries attestations a and b. Absence pruning (section 4.1): the votes counted in a votes step are included at `included_at` (default target height + 1); an include step records votes of the listed keys included at `height` (only entries of the configuration in force; result = the keys recorded); a rejoin step: the block at `height` of epoch `block_epoch` carries the rejoin (signed for chain 0x4F420002 when other_chain, 32 zero bytes when bad_sig). pruned: key -> the epoch its pruning started; rejoins: key -> height of its pending rejoin. A handoff to C_x reads the history up to opening(x) only (bans, rejoins, the absence window (opening(x-4), opening(x)] and its quorum gate). growth_cap (when present): the provider is the growth cap (obb_growth_cap.advance with params 'obenblock') over this share-work history, the keys excluded at each epoch it steps being the chain's; provider_calls are its outputs.
notes.certificates: verdict: verify_certificate against trusted_config's entries; verdict_with_proof: verify_certificate_with_proof against trusted_config.config_id and registry_proof (absent when the certificate does not decode or names a key outside the configuration)
